title.en: An Act Fixing the Boundaries of the Barrios of Binagbag and Salvacion in the Municipality of Agdangan, Province of Quezon
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Boundaries of the Barrios of Binagbag and Salvacion in the Municipality of Agdangan, Province of Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2779_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The barrio of Binagbag in the Municipality of Agdangan, Province of Quezon, shall be bounded on the North by the Manila Railroad Line; on the East by Lots Numbers 387, 386, 385, 382, and Bolo River; on the West by Lots Numbers 426, 425, 424, 423, 421, 3175, 420, and 418, and on the South by Tayabas Bay.
The barrio of Salvacion in the Municipality of Agdangan, Province of Quezon, shall be bounded on the North by the Manila Railroad Line, on the East by Lots Numbers 422, 323, 413, 414, 415, and 417; on the West by Lots Numbers 816, 1125, 818, 456, 452, and 453, and on the South by Tayabas Bay.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
